pages.summary: El Expreso de Hogwarts llega a Londres después de un viaje agotador con los bebés.

panels.scene: Cinematic wide red steam locomotive coming gently to stop under iron and glass station roof, wheel vapor, December light, bundled people waiting at safe distance. One small station placard says exactly 9¾.
panels.caption: El Expreso de Hogwarts llegó envuelto en vapor.

panels.scene: Montage flashback to a crowded but orderly narrow train aisle earlier. Students in warm coats maneuver luggage and baby bags, safely supported children, no falling person or luggage near infants.
panels.caption: Ocho horas de viaje habían agotado a todos.

panels.scene: Daphne in dark green winter coat and cream scarf sits by frosty window, weary, holding fair-haired Arianna in beige with matching little frown. Blaise quietly waits nearby.
panels.caption: Daphne y Arianna compartían el mismo gesto.

panels.scene: Draco disheveled platinum hair and crooked green tie, gray scarf, holding his head with one hand, while Astoria in dark coat safely cradles sleeping platinum Scorpius in cream.
panels.caption: Scorpius por fin se había dormido.

panels.scene: Tracey with high brown ponytail in green winter coat opens compartment door. Wayne in mustard scarf supports ONE cream bundled Caitlyn. Both politely exhausted.
dialogue: Tracey: ¿Podemos pedir asilo en este compartimento?

panels.scene: Blaise glances toward everyone with amused tired eyes, hands lowered, dark coat. Daphne behind him and Arianna asleep safely.
dialogue: Blaise: Hay sitio si nadie vuelve a dejar caer un baúl.

pages.transcript:
Capítulo 12 · 01

El Expreso de Hogwarts llega a Londres después de un viaje agotador con los bebés.
Narración: El Expreso de Hogwarts llegó envuelto en vapor.
9¾
HOGWARTS EXPRESS
Narración: Ocho horas de viaje habían agotado a todos.
Narración: Daphne y Arianna compartían el mismo gesto.
Narración: Scorpius por fin se había dormido.
Tracey: ¿Podemos pedir asilo en este compartimento?
Blaise: Hay sitio si nadie vuelve a dejar caer un baúl.
pages.review: Se fija el aspecto del tren, del andén y de los abrigos. Se transcriben la placa 9¾ y el nombre de la locomotora.

pages.summary: Los cuentos de Hermione calman el vagón. Pansy busca a los Granger entre la gente del andén.

panels.scene: Hermione seated at compartment corner, burgundy coat open and cream scarf loose. One Robin sits supported on her lap, open fairy tale book on table next to them. Front cover partly visible, short title only.
printed: Los cuentos de Beedle el Bardo
panels.caption: Hermione leyó en voz alta durante buena parte del viaje.

panels.scene: Fair-haired Arianna in beige on Daphne's lap listens wide-eyed. Blaise rests by them, captivated despite himself. Warm brass and frosted glass.
panels.caption: Hasta los más pequeños guardaron silencio.

panels.scene: Theo and Luna listen from opposite seat, support their two distinct twins in navy white, human fingers and faces. Pansy is not in this frame.
panels.caption: A los padres tampoco les hizo falta que se lo pidieran.

panels.scene: Astoria securely cradles one sleeping platinum Scorpius. Draco now rests his shoulders and closes his eyes, loose hair and tie. Compartment warm light.
panels.caption: Por fin hubo un rato de paz.

panels.scene: Cut to present by station window. Pansy rigid beside frosted glass in charcoal coat and dark green scarf, black gloved fingers clutch coat hem. Blurred faces outside station glass.
panels.caption: A Pansy, en cambio, le esperaba otra prueba.

panels.scene: Pansy peers out from window, green eyes worried but dignified, one dark coat and black chin bob. Small thought balloon clearly a thought.
dialogue: Pansy, pensando: ¿Qué aspecto tiene un dentista?

pages.summary: Blaise se burla del discurso con el que Pansy intenta tranquilizarse.

panels.scene: Pansy sits beside frosty train window looking ahead, tiny frown, black gloves gripping charcoal coat. She mutters to herself, no strangers.
dialogue: Pansy: Somos fuertes, implacables e indestructibles…

panels.scene: Blaise dark skin short black curls lounges on opposite burgundy bench, smiles with one raised eyebrow, Daphne behind him closed-eyed with Arianna safe.
dialogue: Blaise: Son un manojo de nervios.

panels.scene: Blaise continues speaking with a gently teasing smile, her black glove and coat edge in foreground.
dialogue: Blaise: Vas a conocer a dos dentistas. En el peor caso, examinarán tu mordida.

panels.scene: Pansy tilts chin and presses lips with dignified green-eyed look. One black gloved hand loosens on coat.
dialogue: Pansy: No estoy nerviosa.

panels.scene: Close black gloved hand smoothing wrinkled charcoal wool, little gold window reflection. Blaise's balloon from outside the frame.
dialogue: Blaise, fuera de cuadro: ¿Es una técnica para quitar arrugas?

panels.scene: Hermione across aisle lowers open Beedle book, smiles at the joke, Robin safely held in her lap, eyes green and brown curls. Pansy looks sideways while smiling despite herself.
panels.caption: Robin soltó una risita que pareció darle la razón a Blaise.

pages.summary: Los amigos se despiden hasta las vacaciones en Amalfi. Hermione y Pansy se quedan con Robin.

panels.scene: Train side door opens to busy platform with steam, warm bags and winter coats. Families depart with rolling trunks, no more than two figures close. View from inside.
panels.caption: En cuanto abrieron las puertas, el vagón empezó a vaciarse.

panels.scene: In compartment Daphne stands with sleepy fair-haired Arianna securely in arms, cream scarf and green coat. Blaise takes her dark leather trunk. Hermione and Pansy still seated.
dialogue: Daphne: Escríbannos en cuanto lleguen.

panels.scene: Tracey with Wayne and cream baby Caitlyn leave in distance, Draco and Astoria carrying Scorpius follow. Winter coats, luggage at ground level.
panels.caption: La despedida duraría hasta que volvieran a reunirse en Amalfi.

panels.scene: Daphne pauses at compartment doorway and looks at Pansy with an amused reassuring expression. She supports one beige-clad Arianna. Pansy stiff by window in dark green scarf.
dialogue: Daphne: Deja de parecer tan aterrada.

panels.scene: Pansy glances back dryly, keeps black gloves at hem. Hermione smiles, supports one tiny Robin in navy and beige.
dialogue: Pansy: Te agradecería el consejo si supiera seguirlo.

panels.scene: Quiet empty compartment, gray steam outside frosted windows, Hermione puts book in bag with free hand, Robin on her lap. Pansy still seated facing open door, no other people.
panels.caption: Al final solo quedaron ellas y Robin.

pages.summary: Hermione tranquiliza a Pansy antes de bajar. El equipaje revela cuánto ha preparado para Robin.

panels.scene: Hermione stands in empty compartment holding Robin securely with her left arm, offering her free right hand to seated Pansy. Pansy looks up nervously, black gloves.
dialogue: Hermione: Mamá lleva semanas contando los días para conocerte.

panels.scene: Hermione smiles reassuringly, Robin grips her cream scarf with tiny fingers. Pansy remains seated, looking up.
dialogue: Hermione: Papá hizo una lista de preguntas sobre el mundo mágico.

panels.scene: Pansy looks at the open compartment door, thin green eyes, one eyebrow up, hands relaxed.
dialogue: Pansy: Eso último no me tranquiliza.

panels.scene: Pansy accepts Hermione’s hand and stands. Two properly connected hands in clasp, Robin safe against Hermione's other arm.
dialogue: Hermione: Mis padres se dedican a arreglar dientes, Pansy.

panels.scene: Pansy raises her wand and exactly three dark leather trunks float safely in a line down the empty aisle, two large and one small. Hermione and Robin wait outside the luggage path.
panels.caption: Los dos baúles grandes iban seguidos por uno para Robin.

panels.scene: Hermione raises her eyebrow fondly at luggage. Pansy glances back at her, black gloves and forest scarf, same baby in Hermione’s arms.
dialogue: Hermione: Dijiste que solo habías empacado lo indispensable.
Pansy: Y lo hice.

Images 1 and 2 are permanent original Hermione and Pansy face references. Use their distinctive older student proportions, fine ink and painterly color. Hermione has BROWN irises, freckles and abundant chestnut curls. Her oval midnight blue sapphire with a clear diamond halo hangs on a fine WHITE PLATINUM chain at the front of her chest. Pansy has a tapered angular jaw, slender green almond eyes, flat sleek side parted black bob ending at the chin, and bare ears. Natural individual expressions and no face cloning.
Image 3 is reference for the same train compartment, wool coats, scarves and lighting only.
December King’s Cross platform with iron-and-glass arched roof, brick wall and red Hogwarts Express at right, gray steam and winter light. Hermione in long burgundy wool coat with cream scarf and full school clothes underneath, white platinum sapphire at front if visible. Pansy elegant charcoal wool coat and forest-green scarf with black gloves, distinct green eyes and flat black chin-length bob. Robin human small baby brown curls green eyes, navy cardigan beige trousers cream socks, wrapped loosely and securely in cream winter blanket outside. Exactly three dark leather trunks when visible, TWO large with small silver crests and ONE small for Robin. Jane Granger is a distinct middle-aged woman, shoulder length brown hair with subtle gray at temples, warm brown eyes and friendly adult face, camel wool coat and sage scarf. Malcolm is a middle-aged man, dark brown hair with light gray at temples, rectangular dark-rimmed glasses, brown eyes, charcoal overcoat and navy plaid scarf. Warm restrained fatherly expression. Both keep these appearances and clothes. Inside the empty compartment first, dark oak, burgundy bench, frosted window, brass luggage rack and side door. Only Hermione, Pansy and one Robin.
All infants are human in appearance with smooth skin, individual tiny fingers and natural limbs. Knitted texture belongs to clothes. Keep ages, clothes, hair, hands, colors, objects and locations continuous across panels. Show an ordinary fully clothed school and family story.
Place the small black serif header «Capítulo 12 · 05» on the top-left cream margin. Thin black rectangular panel outlines, narrow cream gutters, large readable speech balloons and captions with clear tails. Read left to right, top to bottom. Print only the exact text in quotation marks in the panel list and the header, with all Spanish accents. Speaker names specify balloon tails and are not printed. No added words, footer or watermark.
Panel 1. Hermione stands in empty compartment holding Robin securely with her left arm, offering her free right hand to seated Pansy. Pansy looks up nervously, black gloves. Balloon from Hermione. Print verbatim «Mamá lleva semanas contando los días para conocerte.»
Panel 2. Hermione smiles reassuringly, Robin grips her cream scarf with tiny fingers. Pansy remains seated, looking up. Balloon from Hermione. Print verbatim «Papá hizo una lista de preguntas sobre el mundo mágico.»
Panel 3. Pansy looks at the open compartment door, thin green eyes, one eyebrow up, hands relaxed. Balloon from Pansy. Print verbatim «Eso último no me tranquiliza.»
Panel 4. Pansy accepts Hermione’s hand and stands. Two properly connected hands in clasp, Robin safe against Hermione's other arm. Balloon from Hermione. Print verbatim «Mis padres se dedican a arreglar dientes, Pansy.»
Panel 5. Pansy raises her wand and exactly three dark leather trunks float safely in a line down the empty aisle, two large and one small. Hermione and Robin wait outside the luggage path. Caption verbatim «Los dos baúles grandes iban seguidos por uno para Robin.»
Panel 6. Hermione raises her eyebrow fondly at luggage. Pansy glances back at her, black gloves and forest scarf, same baby in Hermione’s arms. Balloon from Hermione. Print verbatim «Dijiste que solo habías empacado lo indispensable.» Balloon from Pansy. Print verbatim «Y lo hice.»

pages.summary: Pansy recuerda el consejo de Eirena y baja al andén con Hermione y Robin.

panels.scene: Hermione and Pansy step down from red train into cold steam, safely holding Robin. Pansy in charcoal coat looks nervous, gray steam and families around.
panels.caption: El aire helado devolvió todos los nervios de Pansy.

panels.scene: Flashback with cream tinted border. A few days earlier, Pansy fully clothed in green school uniform speaks to silver mirror on wooden table. Eirena inside mirror.
panels.caption: Recordó la conversación con sus padres.

panels.scene: Close silver mirror. Mature Eirena in dark teal, pearl earrings, warm stern expression, speaks from mirror. Markus seated behind her tries not to smile.
dialogue: Eirena: Cuida de Hermione y causa una buena primera impresión.

panels.scene: Pansy in full green uniform before mirror, chin raised. Eirena and Markus only reflections, not in room.
dialogue: Pansy: No tienen de qué preocuparse.

panels.scene: Back to winter platform. Robin in Hermione's arms waves one tiny human hand toward steam locomotive, green eyes and brown curls, delighted.
panels.caption: Un balbuceo la devolvió al andén.

panels.scene: Hermione spots her parents near brick wall, smiles toward them and offers Pansy her free hand. They head forward together, three trunks behind at safe distance.
dialogue: Hermione: ¡Allí están!

pages.summary: Jane y Malcolm reciben a su hija y conocen a Robin y Pansy.

panels.scene: Wide station brick wall, Jane with warm brown hair graying at temples and sage scarf stands beside Malcolm with rectangular dark glasses, charcoal coat and navy plaid scarf. Both adults smile at approaching family.
panels.caption: Jane y Malcolm esperaban junto al muro de ladrillo.

panels.scene: Malcolm glances briefly from the girls' clasped hands to Pansy, wary but courteous. Jane smiles with open warmth, eyes toward Hermione. No other people near their faces.
panels.caption: Pansy reconoció al instante la mirada protectora de Malcolm.

panels.scene: Hermione approaches with one Robin held safely high against her chest, burgundy coat and cream scarf. Pansy walks a step behind in charcoal.
dialogue: Hermione: ¡Mamá! ¡Papá!

panels.scene: Jane hugs Hermione gently from one side, leaving plenty of room for securely supported Robin in Hermione’s arms. Adult Jane camel coat and sage scarf. Pansy and Malcolm stand clear.
dialogue: Jane: ¡Qué alegría tenerte en casa!

panels.scene: Jane leans back to admire Robin, offers one finger he lightly holds, tiny human fingers and green eyes. Hermione keeps supporting him.
dialogue: Jane: Es precioso. Mira esos ojos, Malcolm.

panels.scene: Hermione hugs Malcolm with one arm, Robin safe in her other arm. Jane smiles nearby. Pansy waits poised with both black gloves relaxed.
panels.caption: Solo quedaba la presentación que Pansy llevaba horas ensayando.

pages.summary: Pansy intenta un saludo formal. Jane la abraza y Robin acaba por conquistar a los Granger.

panels.scene: Pansy faces Jane and Malcolm at friendly distance on station platform, black gloves and charcoal coat with green scarf, chin up, polished formal expression. Hermione holds Robin near Jane.
dialogue: Pansy: Señora Granger, señor Granger. Es un placer conocerlos.

panels.scene: Jane in camel coat and sage scarf gives Pansy a brief side hug, both people upright, Pansy surprised but smiling. Hermione safely holds Robin separately nearby.
dialogue: Jane: Teníamos muchas ganas de conocerte, cariño.

panels.scene: Malcolm offers his hand to Pansy with a small reserved smile. Exact two hands in handshake. Adult rectangular glasses distinct from any student.
dialogue: Malcolm: Hermione también nos habla mucho de sus estudios.

panels.scene: Pansy smiles politely at him. Hermione gives her father a knowing glance, one Robin in her arms.
dialogue: Pansy: No sería tan insensata como para competir con ellos.

panels.scene: Clearly shown handoff. Hermione gently transfers one baby Robin to Jane, both with natural supporting arms, Robin in navy and cream. Pansy and Malcolm hands down, no duplicate infant.
dialogue: Jane: Ven aquí, pequeño.

panels.scene: Close Jane supports Robin against camel coat; he reaches one tiny finger to her sage scarf and smiles. Malcolm's expression softens at right. Pansy notices from beside Hermione.
panels.caption: Robin ya se había ganado a los Granger.

pages.transcript:
Capítulo 12 · 08

Pansy intenta un saludo formal. Jane la abraza y Robin acaba por conquistar a los Granger.
Pansy: Señora Granger, señor Granger. Es un placer conocerlos.
Jane: Teníamos muchas ganas de conocerte, cariño.
Malcolm: Hermione también nos habla mucho de sus estudios.
Pansy: No sería tan insensata como para competir con ellos.
Jane: Ven aquí, pequeño.
Narración: Robin ya se había ganado a los Granger.
pages.review: Jane y Malcolm mantienen los diseños del andén. El traspaso de Robin de Hermione a Jane se ve de forma explícita y con apoyo en brazos.
